The site is CleanTech Trades Network — Heat Pump & Solar Apprenticeships, a job-board web application for Local heat pump and solar installer apprenticeships.

Owner brief: "Our regional green economy council is launching an apprenticeship board connecting clean energy contractors with trainee heat pump technicians and solar installers. Candidates must be able to search openings by trade category, read job descriptions and wage rates, and submit an application with an introduction note. Applications must be saved on the server so applicants can check their submission status."

Locale & copy conventions (en-GB): Use £ prices, British English spelling, day-month dates and .co.uk-style invented domains. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-12/reference.jpg).

Art direction: CleanTech Trades Network — Heat Pump & Solar Apprenticeships: the page for local heat pump and solar installer apprenticeships, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #0f172a (ct-slate), #1e293b (ct-surface), #0d9488 (ct-teal), #f59e0b (ct-amber), #334155 (ct-border), #f8fafc (ct-text), #94a3b8 (ct-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 8px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--ct-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.
